'''Rabaan''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who led an expedition to colonize that [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rabaan|Ishanna III]]. He rejected the spacefaring ways of his people to lead a simpler life. The colonists renamed the planet in his honor.<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Combat Moon (short story)}}</ref>
